title: Law firm or lawyer (YMYL, regulated advertising)
basis: Recalled general knowledge, 2026-10-22; hosts not re-fetched (UNVERIFIED). Lawyer advertising is regulated by each state bar (the ABA model rules are the template); the pack marks awards that are bought.

domainTypes.note: claim the lawyer profile; website field
do not call it earned unless you were selected; follow your state's rules on stating it
legal information with a lawyer directory

patterns.why: a state or local bar or lawyers association
a law school, legal aid or clinic

angles: Claim and complete the Avvo, Justia and Martindale profiles with identical bar number, name, address and phone.
Join the state bar sections and the local bar association; fill the 'find a lawyer' profile.
Publish plain-language guides for the practice area and the county (court forms, deadlines, what happens next) that local libraries, legal aid pages and reporters can cite.
Offer a free talk or clinic to a library, school, senior centre or community group; ask for the event page link.
Answer reporter requests in your practice area with a fact and a quote; local news and legal-news sites link to sources.
Teach a CLE class or contribute to a bar publication; the association page links the author.
avoid: Buying 'Top Attorney' or 'Best Lawyer' awards; many are pay-to-play and state bars restrict how to claim them.
Reviews posted by the firm or by friends, and reviews that name client matters (confidentiality).
Paid links on law-blog networks: legal is one of the most abused niches and the most checked.
Promising results in listings. State bar advertising rules apply.
